text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*!!
...I will!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I wiiiiilll!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOO...!!)

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was quite a race to watch.
Personally, Dantsu Flame's desperate
effort left a real impression on me.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: This year's Classic Triple Crown gives us yet another thing to look forward to, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I-I did it...!
I did it, Trainer...!!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that!?
I've changed, haven't I!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I could really feel a huge boost
in my explosive power, speed, and endurance."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure this is because... I've learned
how to properly channel my feelings!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ngggh, yes sir!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: To be honest, back when we first started sharing our opinions with each other, I was a little anxious.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I struggled much more than I expected.
But... I'm glad, I was truly able to change!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best in the Classic campaign too!
Toward the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The curtain fell on the Kisaragi Sho
with Dantsu Flame smiling brightly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later. While walking outside to shop for daily necessities...

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Wha, big sis, you run in the Twinkle Series!?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
No waaay!!
I don't even know their name!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm not lying, it's the truth~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I spotted Dantsu Flame being teased by the children...!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
"Then prove it!
Catch me within three seconds!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, that seems a bit dangerous, maybe~?
Isn't there another way?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
No way!
I mean, if you can't do it, that means you lied!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was so completely one-sided that before I knew it,
I had spoken up to intervene.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Trainer?
This person?
choice_data_list: Dantsu Frame is strong, I'm telling you!
Dantsu Frame is strong, you know!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how high the wall, I'll never give up.
I can keep running wholeheartedly toward my dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if the name is still unknown right now,
eventually, everyone will come to know Dants Flame's passion—
the fire burning within her.
choice_data_list: She's a special girl who could even become the star of a new era!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Aweeeesomeee!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (A special girl who could even become the star of a new era, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Has anyone ever... expected so much from me before?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Has anyone ever looked at me... that closely before—)

text_block_list.name: Former Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
I heard Dantsu-chan's transferring again,
even though she just got here the other day.

text_block_list.name: Former Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, is that so~?
That was fast.

text_block_list.name: Former Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, what are you doing this weekend?
Word is the girls in our class are going to the beach—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (They weren't there, were they?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Special", huh...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ("Trainer,")

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(“If you'd like, dinner tomorrow—”
............)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
T-That would naturally surprise anyone, wouldn't it?
Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I'll leave it for next time.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next is finally the Satsuki Sho.
For the first race of the Classic campaign,
I want to make sure I run a solid race!
